answer: Under EigenTrust, reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, reciprocated honest service to retain influence. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits score amplification through colluding links; a fresh sybil, lacking trusted paths, has near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot pass consensus. Verified interaction is the inlet to trust, not a crystal-clear claim or an arbitrary anchor.
